import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountWelcome } from '../templates/scaffold/app/application.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountWelcome(element, onError, {
		i18n,
		onThemeChange: (theme) =>
			document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('asam-preview-theme-request', { detail: theme }))
	});
	return result;
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	theme(event.detail);
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { NavigationShell } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import { contextKey } from './context.js';
import settings from './settings.json';
defineProps<{ welcome: boolean }>();
const context = inject(contextKey);
if (!context) throw new Error('Host context required');
const { navigation, preferences, i18n, hostLocale, hostTheme } = context;
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
function chooseSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function language(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'string') preferences.choose({ locale: value });
}
function theme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark' || value === 'system')
		preferences.choose({ theme: value });
}
</script>

vue
<!-- SFC formatting follows Prettier; avoid competing template layout rewrites. -->
<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent, vue/html-closing-bracket-newline, vue/html-self-closing, vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
	<section class="synthetic-page">
		<h1>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.title') }}</h1>
		<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.intro') }}</p>
		<AsamSearchForm :controller="queryController" :columns="3" :collapsed-count="3" compact card
			><template #actions
				><AsamButton @click="cancel" type="primary">{{
					i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.cancel')
				}}</AsamButton></template
			></AsamSearchForm
		>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite" data-request-state>
			{{
				loading
					? i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.loading')
					: error ||
						i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.summary', {
							total: result.total,
							page: result.page
						})
			}}
		</p>
		<div v-if="error" role="alert">
			<p>{{ error }}</p>
			<AsamButton @click="recover" type="primary">{{
				i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.retry')
			}}</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p v-else-if="!loading && !result.rows.length" data-empty>
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.empty') }}
		</p>
		<div v-else class="synthetic-table" :aria-busy="loading">
			<table>
				<caption>
					{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.caption')
					}}
				</caption>
				<thead>
					<tr>
						<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.id') }}</th>
						<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.name') }}</th>
						<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.amount') }}</th>
						<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.date') }}</th>
					</tr>
				</thead>
				<tbody>
					<tr
						v-for="(row, index) in result.rows"
						:key="`${typeof row.id}:${String(row.id)}:${index}`"
					>
						<td>{{ identity(row.id) }}</td>
						<td>{{ row.name }}</td>
						<td>{{ preferences.number(row.amount) }}</td>
						<td>{{ row.createdAt.slice(0, 10) }}</td>
					</tr>
				</tbody>
			</table>
		</div>
		<div class="synthetic-controls">
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				:disabled="result.page <= 1 || loading"
				@click="load(result.page - 1)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.previous') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				type="default"
				:disabled="result.page * 20 >= result.total || loading"
				@click="load(result.page + 1)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.next') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInputNumber, defineAsamControl, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamSearchForm, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createLatestRequest, RequestFailure } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { useScaffoldI18n } from './I18n.js';
import { contextKey } from './context.js';
import { decodePage } from './Mock.js';
import type { Page, Scenario, SyntheticRecord } from './Mock.js';
import settings from './settings.json';
const context = inject(contextKey);
if (!context) throw new Error('Host context required');
const { preferences, client, mock } = context;
const i18n = useScaffoldI18n();
const result = ref<Page>({ rows: [], total: 0, page: 1, pageSize: 20 });
const scenarios: Scenario[] = ['normal', 'empty', 'business', 'network', 'offline', 'late'];
const resetValues = { query: '', seed: settings.seed, scenario: 'normal' };
const seedControl = defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
	component: AsamInputNumber,
	emptyValue: () => null,
	sourceKinds: []
});
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => [
	{
		key: 'query',
		kind: 'text',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.query')
	},
	{
		key: 'seed',
		kind: 'custom',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.seed'),
		control: seedControl,
		isValue: (value) => value == null || typeof value === 'number',
		emptyValue: () => null,
		isEmpty: (value) => value == null,
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		format: (value) => String(value ?? ''),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min: 0, max: 4294967295 } } }
	},
	{
		key: 'scenario',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.scenario'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: scenarios.map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))
		})
	}
]);
const errorCode = ref<'' | 'cancelled' | 'request' | 'invalidData' | 'invalidSeed'>('');
const failedKind = ref('');
const error = computed(() => {
	switch (errorCode.value) {
		case 'cancelled':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.cancelled');
		case 'request':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.requestFailed', { kind: failedKind.value });
		case 'invalidData':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.invalidData');
		case 'invalidSeed':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.invalidSeed');
		default:
			return '';
	}
});
const loading = ref(false);
let revision = 0;
const latest = createLatestRequest<Page>(client, (value) => {
	result.value = value;
});
const identity = (id: SyntheticRecord['id']) =>
	`${id === null ? 'null' : typeof id}:${JSON.stringify(id)}`;
// 生成工程使用固定版本的 Pro 包，查询界面接入该版本已有的控制器契约。
const queryController = useAsamListController<SyntheticRecord>({
	fields,
	initial: { ...resetValues, scenario: settings.scenario },
	immediate: false,
	rowKey: (row) => identity(row.id),
	async api({ query, currentPage }, { signal }) {
		try {
			if (typeof query.seed !== 'number') throw new TypeError('Expected a numeric seed');
			mock.reset(query.seed);
		} catch (error) {
			errorCode.value = 'invalidSeed';
			throw error;
		}
		const data = await requestPage(currentPage, query, signal);
		return { list: data.rows, total: data.total };
	}
});
queryController.setResetBaseline(resetValues);
async function requestPage(page: number, filters: AsamFieldModel, signal?: AbortSignal) {
	const current = ++revision;
	errorCode.value = '';
	loading.value = true;
	try {
		mock.setScenario(scenarios.find((value) => value === filters.scenario) ?? 'normal');
		return await latest.load(
			{
				url: '/synthetic/records',
				params: { query: String(filters.query ?? ''), page, pageSize: 20 }
			},
			{ decode: decodePage, signal }
		);
	} catch (cause) {
		if (current === revision) {
			errorCode.value =
				cause instanceof RequestFailure
					? cause.kind === 'cancelled'
						? 'cancelled'
						: 'request'
					: 'invalidData';
			failedKind.value = cause instanceof RequestFailure ? cause.kind : '';
		}
		throw cause;
	} finally {
		if (current === revision) loading.value = false;
	}
}
function load(page = 1) {
	void requestPage(page, queryController.draft.value).catch(() => {
		// 请求失败已通过页面状态呈现。
	});
}
function cancel() {
	latest.cancel();
}
function recover() {
	queryController.setDraft({ ...queryController.draft.value, scenario: 'normal' });
	void load();
}
onMounted(() => {
	void load();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	revision++;
	latest.dispose();
});
</script>
<style scoped>
.synthetic-page {
	padding: 12px;
	animation: enter 160ms ease-out;
}
.synthetic-page h1 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl, 24px);
}
.synthetic-controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 8px;
	margin-block: 12px;
}
.synthetic-table {
	max-width: 100%;
	overflow: auto;
}
table {

	text-align: left;
}
td,
th {

}
@keyframes enter {
	from {
		opacity: 0;
		transform: translateY(3px);
	}
	to {

		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.synthetic-page {
		animation: none;
	}
}
</style>

import { TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type {
	RequestInput,
	TransportContext,
	TransportResponse
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';

export type Scenario = 'normal' | 'empty' | 'business' | 'network' | 'offline' | 'late';
export interface SyntheticRecord {
	id: number | string | null | false;
	name: string;
	amount: number;
	createdAt: string;
}
export interface Page {
	rows: SyntheticRecord[];
	total: number;
	page: number;
	pageSize: number;
}
export interface MockOptions {
	seed: number;
	scenario?: Scenario;
	delayMs?: number;
	count?: number;
	/** Injection makes delay/cancellation tests independent of wall time. */
	schedule?: (callback: () => void, delay: number) => () => void;
}
const scenarios: Scenario[] = ['normal', 'empty', 'business', 'network', 'offline', 'late'];
const timeBase = 1704067200000;
export function records(seed: number, count = 100): SyntheticRecord[] {
	if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 0xffffffff)
		throw new Error('uint32 seed required');
	if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > 10000)
		throw new Error('count must be 0..10000');
	let state = seed >>> 0;
	const next = () => {
		state = (Math.imul(state, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
		return state;
	};
	const identities: SyntheticRecord['id'][] = [0, '0', null, false];
	return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
		id: index < 4 ? identities[index]! : index,
		name: `合成记录 ${index + 1} · ${next().toString(16).slice(0, 6)}`,
		amount: next() % 10000,
		createdAt: new Date(timeBase + (next() % 365) * 86400000).toISOString()
	}));
}
export function createMock(options: MockOptions) {
	let seed = options.seed;
	let data = records(seed, options.count);
	let scenario = options.scenario ?? 'normal';
	let disposed = false;
	let sequence = 0;
	const pending = new Map<number, () => void>();
	const schedule =
		options.schedule ??
		((callback, delay) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(callback, delay);
			return () => clearTimeout(timer);
		});
	function setScenario(next: Scenario) {
		if (!scenarios.includes(next)) throw new Error('Unknown scenario');
		scenario = next;
	}
	setScenario(scenario);
	const delay = options.delayMs ?? 160;
	if (!Number.isInteger(delay) || delay < 0 || delay > 30000)
		throw new Error('delayMs must be 0..30000');
	function transport(input: RequestInput, context: TransportContext): Promise<TransportResponse> {
		const mode = scenario;
		const snapshot = data;
		const number = ++sequence;
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let cancelTimer = () => {};
			let settled = false;
			const cleanup = () => {
				cancelTimer();
				context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				pending.delete(number);
			};
			const abort = () => {
				if (settled) return;
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
			};
			if (disposed || context.signal.aborted) {
				abort();
				return;
			}
			context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			pending.set(number, abort);
			cancelTimer = schedule(
				() => {
					if (settled) return;
					settled = true;
					cleanup();
					if (mode === 'offline' || mode === 'network' || mode === 'business') {
						reject(new TransportFault(mode));
						return;
					}
					const page = Number(input.params?.page ?? 1);
					const pageSize = Number(input.params?.pageSize ?? 20);
					if (
						input.url !== '/synthetic/records' ||
						!Number.isInteger(page) ||
						page < 1 ||
						!Number.isInteger(pageSize) ||
						pageSize < 1 ||
						pageSize > 100
					) {
						reject(new TransportFault('business'));
						return;
					}
					const query = String(input.params?.query ?? '').toLowerCase();
					const rows =
						mode === 'empty'
							? []
							: snapshot.filter((row) => row.name.toLowerCase().includes(query));
					resolve({
						mode: 'data',
						data: {
							rows: rows.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize),
							total: rows.length,
							page,
							pageSize
						} satisfies Page
					});
				},
				mode === 'late' ? delay * 8 : delay
			);
		});
	}
	return {
		transport,
		setScenario,
		reset(nextSeed = seed) {
			const next = records(nextSeed, options.count);
			for (const abort of pending.values()) abort();
			seed = nextSeed;
			data = next;
			scenario = options.scenario ?? 'normal';
		},
		get pending() {
			return pending.size;
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			for (const abort of pending.values()) abort();
		}
	};
}
export function decodePage(value: unknown): Page {
	if (
		!value ||
		typeof value !== 'object' ||
		!('rows' in value) ||
		!Array.isArray(value.rows) ||
		!('total' in value) ||
		typeof value.total !== 'number' ||
		!('page' in value) ||
		typeof value.page !== 'number' ||
		!('pageSize' in value) ||
		typeof value.pageSize !== 'number'
	)
		throw new Error('Invalid page');
	for (const row of value.rows) {
		if (
			!row ||
			typeof row !== 'object' ||
			(!['number', 'string'].includes(typeof row.id) &&
				row.id !== null &&
				row.id !== false) ||
			typeof row.name !== 'string' ||
			typeof row.amount !== 'number' ||
			typeof row.createdAt !== 'string'
		)
			throw new Error('Invalid row');
	}
	return value as Page;
}

});

import { computed, createApp, defineComponent, h, watch } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHashHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createNavigation } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import {
	browserStorage,
	createPreferences,
	bindPreferencesI18n
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { createRequestClient, createTransportProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { scaffoldMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import App from './App.vue';
import DataPage from './DataPage.vue';
import AboutPage from './AboutPage.vue';
import WelcomePage from './WelcomePage.vue';
import WorkspaceGuide from './WorkspaceGuide.vue';
import { contextKey } from './context.js';
import { createMock } from './Mock.js';
import settings from './settings.json';
import type { Scenario } from './Mock.js';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

/** 可选宿主只提供外部语言源和主题变更通知，不转移本应用资源的归属。 */
export interface WelcomeHost {
	i18n?: AsamI18n;
	onThemeChange?: (theme: 'light' | 'dark') => void;
}

/** The host owns every instance and calls the returned disposer before remounting. */
export function mountApplication(element: Element, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
	return mountScaffold(element, '/data', onError);
}

/** 独立欢迎入口；默认数据入口及其销毁契约保持一致。 */
export function mountWelcome(
	element: Element,
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
	host?: WelcomeHost
) {
	return mountScaffold(element, '/welcome', onError, host);
}

async function mountScaffold(
	element: Element,
	initialPath: '/data' | '/welcome',
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
	host?: WelcomeHost
) {
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHashHistory(),
		routes: [
			{
				path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*',
				component: defineComponent(
					() => () => h('p', i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.unmatched'))
				)
			}
		]
	});
	const mock = createMock({ seed: settings.seed, scenario: settings.scenario as Scenario });
	const preferences = createPreferences({
		app: settings.namespace,
		owner: ['synthetic-demo', 0],
		storage: browserStorage(),
		dictionaries: {
			'zh-CN': {
				welcome: '欢迎',
				data: '合成数据',
				about: '工程说明',
				search: '查询',
				reset: '恢复默认',
				cancel: '取消',
				title: '可复现数据演示'
			},
			'en-US': {
				welcome: 'Welcome',
				data: 'Synthetic data',
				about: 'About',
				search: 'Search',
				reset: 'Reset',
				cancel: 'Cancel',
				title: 'Reproducible data demo'
			}
		},
		fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN',
		initial: { locale: settings.locale, theme: settings.theme as 'light' | 'dark' | 'system' },
		system: window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
	});
	const stopHostLocale = host?.i18n
		? watch(
				host.i18n.locale,
				(locale) => preferences.choose({ locale: locale === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN' }),
				{ immediate: true }
			)
		: undefined;
	const stopHostTheme = host?.onThemeChange
		? watch(preferences.colorMode, (theme) => host.onThemeChange?.(theme))
		: undefined;
	// Preserve the historical stored en-US ID; adapt this template's explicit choice to builtin en.
	const componentLocale = computed(() =>
		preferences.locale.value === 'en-US' ? 'en' : preferences.locale.value
	);
	const preferenceScope = bindPreferencesI18n(
		{ locale: componentLocale },
		{ fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN' }
	);
	const i18n = extendAsamI18n(preferenceScope, scaffoldMessageDefaults);
	const welcome = initialPath === '/welcome';
	const client = createRequestClient({ i18n, transport: mock.transport });
	const coreItems = [
		{
			id: 'welcome',
			path: '/welcome',
			resource: 'welcome',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.welcome'
		},
		{
			id: 'data',
			path: '/data',
			resource: 'data',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.data',
			pinned: true
		},
		{ id: 'about', path: '/about', resource: 'about', title: 'app.templates.scaffold.about' }
	] as const;
	const guideItems = [
		{
			id: 'scenarios',
			path: '/scenarios',
			resource: 'scenarios',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.scenarios'
		},
		{
			id: 'appearance',
			path: '/appearance',
			resource: 'appearance',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.appearance'
		},
		{
			id: 'integration',
			path: '/integration',
			resource: 'integration',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.integration'
		}
	] as const;
	const items = welcome ? [...coreItems, ...guideItems] : coreItems;
	const guides = Object.fromEntries(
		guideItems.map(({ id }) => [
			id,
			defineComponent(() => () => h(WorkspaceGuide, { page: id }))
		])
	);
	const controller = createNavigation({
		i18n,
		router,
		components: { data: DataPage, about: AboutPage, welcome: WelcomePage, ...guides },
		load: async () => items.map((item) => ({ ...item, title: i18n.t(item.title) })),
		fallback: '/',
		scope: `${settings.namespace}:synthetic`
	});
	// Explicit template-owned menu IDs; only the displayed title changes with the locale.
	const title = (id: string, fallback: string) => {
		const item = items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
		return item ? i18n.t(item.title) : fallback;
	};
	const navigation = {
		...controller,
		visibleMenu: computed(() =>
			controller.visibleMenu.value.map((item) => ({
				...item,
				title: title(item.id, item.title)
			}))
		),
		tabs: computed(() =>
			controller.tabs.value.map((tab) => ({ ...tab, title: title(tab.routeId, tab.title) }))
		)
	};
	const app = createApp(App, { welcome }).use(router);
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.provide(contextKey, {
		navigation,
		preferences,
		i18n,
		client,
		mock,
		hostLocale: !!host?.i18n,
		hostTheme: !!host?.onThemeChange
	});
	provideAsamData(app, createTransportProvider(client));
	await navigation.reload();
	await router.isReady();
	if (router.currentRoute.value.path === '/') await navigation.navigate(initialPath, true);
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		stopHostLocale?.();
		stopHostTheme?.();
		app.unmount();
		navigation.dispose();
		client.dispose();
		mock.dispose();
		i18n.dispose();
		preferenceScope.dispose();
		preferences.dispose();
	};
}

import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { NavigationController } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import type { PreferenceController } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import type { RequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { createMock } from './Mock.js';
export interface ApplicationContext {
	navigation: NavigationController;
	preferences: PreferenceController;
	i18n: AsamI18n;
	client: RequestClient;
	mock: ReturnType<typeof createMock>;
	hostLocale?: boolean;
	hostTheme?: boolean;
}
export const contextKey: InjectionKey<ApplicationContext> = Symbol('scaffold-host');

					<tr
						v-for="(row, index) in result.rows"
						:key="`${typeof row.id}:${String(row.id)}:${index}`"
					>
						<td>{{ identity(row.id) }}</td>
						<td>{{ row.name }}</td>
						<td>{{ preferences.number(row.amount) }}</td>
						<td>{{ row.createdAt.slice(0, 10) }}</td>
					</tr>
				</tbody>
			</table>
		</div>
		<div class="synthetic-controls">
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				:disabled="result.page <= 1 || loading"
				@click="load(result.page - 1)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.previous') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				type="default"
				:disabled="result.page * 20 >= result.total || loading"
				@click="load(result.page + 1)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.next') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInputNumber, defineAsamControl, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamSearchForm, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createLatestRequest, RequestFailure } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { useScaffoldI18n } from './I18n.js';
import { contextKey } from './context.js';
import { decodePage } from './Mock.js';
import settings from './settings.json';
const context = inject(contextKey);
if (!context) throw new Error('Host context required');
const { preferences, client, mock } = context;
const i18n = useScaffoldI18n();
const result = ref({ rows: [], total: 0, page: 1, pageSize: 20 });
const scenarios = ['normal', 'empty', 'business', 'network', 'offline', 'late'];
const resetValues = { query: '', seed: settings.seed, scenario: 'normal' };
const seedControl = defineAsamControl({
	component: AsamInputNumber,
	emptyValue: () => null,
	sourceKinds: []
});
const fields = computed(() => [
	{
		key: 'query',
		kind: 'text',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.query')
	},
	{
		key: 'seed',
		kind: 'custom',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.seed'),
		control: seedControl,
		isValue: (value) => value == null || typeof value === 'number',
		emptyValue: () => null,
		isEmpty: (value) => value == null,
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		format: (value) => String(value ?? ''),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min: 0, max: 4294967295 } } }
	},
	{
		key: 'scenario',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.scenario'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: scenarios.map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))
		})
	}
]);
const errorCode = ref('');
const failedKind = ref('');
const error = computed(() => {
	switch (errorCode.value) {
		case 'cancelled':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.cancelled');
		case 'request':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.requestFailed', { kind: failedKind.value });
		case 'invalidData':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.invalidData');
		case 'invalidSeed':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.invalidSeed');
		default:
			return '';
	}
});
const loading = ref(false);
let revision = 0;
const latest = createLatestRequest(client, (value) => {
	result.value = value;
});
const identity = (id) => `${id === null ? 'null' : typeof id}:${JSON.stringify(id)}`;
// 生成工程使用固定版本的 Pro 包，查询界面接入该版本已有的控制器契约。
const queryController = useAsamListController({
	fields,
	initial: { ...resetValues, scenario: settings.scenario },
	immediate: false,
	rowKey: (row) => identity(row.id),
	async api({ query, currentPage }, { signal }) {
		try {
			if (typeof query.seed !== 'number') throw new TypeError('Expected a numeric seed');
			mock.reset(query.seed);
		} catch (error) {
			errorCode.value = 'invalidSeed';
			throw error;
		}
		const data = await requestPage(currentPage, query, signal);
		return { list: data.rows, total: data.total };
	}
});
queryController.setResetBaseline(resetValues);
async function requestPage(page, filters, signal) {
	const current = ++revision;
	errorCode.value = '';
	loading.value = true;
	try {
		mock.setScenario(scenarios.find((value) => value === filters.scenario) ?? 'normal');
		return await latest.load(
			{
				url: '/synthetic/records',
				params: { query: String(filters.query ?? ''), page, pageSize: 20 }
			},
			{ decode: decodePage, signal }
		);
	} catch (cause) {
		if (current === revision) {
			errorCode.value =
				cause instanceof RequestFailure
					? cause.kind === 'cancelled'
						? 'cancelled'
						: 'request'
					: 'invalidData';
			failedKind.value = cause instanceof RequestFailure ? cause.kind : '';
		}
		throw cause;
	} finally {
		if (current === revision) loading.value = false;
	}
}
function load(page = 1) {
	void requestPage(page, queryController.draft.value).catch(() => {
		// 请求失败已通过页面状态呈现。
	});
}
function cancel() {
	latest.cancel();
}
function recover() {
	queryController.setDraft({ ...queryController.draft.value, scenario: 'normal' });
	void load();
}
onMounted(() => {
	void load();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	revision++;
	latest.dispose();
});
</script>
<style scoped>
.synthetic-page {
	padding: 12px;
	animation: enter 160ms ease-out;
}
.synthetic-page h1 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl, 24px);
}
.synthetic-controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 8px;
	margin-block: 12px;
}
.synthetic-table {
	max-width: 100%;
	overflow: auto;
}
table {
	width: 100%;
	border-collapse: collapse;
	text-align: left;
}
td,
th {
	padding: 8px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	white-space: nowrap;
}
@keyframes enter {
	from {
		opacity: 0;
		transform: translateY(3px);
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.synthetic-page {
		animation: none;
	}
}
</style>

import { TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
const scenarios = ['normal', 'empty', 'business', 'network', 'offline', 'late'];
const timeBase = 1704067200000;
export function records(seed, count = 100) {
	if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 0xffffffff)
		throw new Error('uint32 seed required');
	if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > 10000)
		throw new Error('count must be 0..10000');
	let state = seed >>> 0;
	const next = () => {
		state = (Math.imul(state, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
		return state;
	};
	const identities = [0, '0', null, false];
	return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
		id: index < 4 ? identities[index] : index,
		name: `合成记录 ${index + 1} · ${next().toString(16).slice(0, 6)}`,
		amount: next() % 10000,
		createdAt: new Date(timeBase + (next() % 365) * 86400000).toISOString()
	}));
}
export function createMock(options) {
	let seed = options.seed;
	let data = records(seed, options.count);
	let scenario = options.scenario ?? 'normal';
	let disposed = false;
	let sequence = 0;
	const pending = new Map();
	const schedule =
		options.schedule ??
		((callback, delay) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(callback, delay);
			return () => clearTimeout(timer);
		});
	function setScenario(next) {
		if (!scenarios.includes(next)) throw new Error('Unknown scenario');
		scenario = next;
	}
	setScenario(scenario);
	const delay = options.delayMs ?? 160;
	if (!Number.isInteger(delay) || delay < 0 || delay > 30000)
		throw new Error('delayMs must be 0..30000');
	function transport(input, context) {
		const mode = scenario;
		const snapshot = data;
		const number = ++sequence;
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let cancelTimer = () => {};
			let settled = false;
			const cleanup = () => {
				cancelTimer();
				context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				pending.delete(number);
			};
			const abort = () => {
				if (settled) return;
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
			};
			if (disposed || context.signal.aborted) {
				abort();
				return;
			}
			context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			pending.set(number, abort);
			cancelTimer = schedule(
				() => {
					if (settled) return;
					settled = true;
					cleanup();
					if (mode === 'offline' || mode === 'network' || mode === 'business') {
						reject(new TransportFault(mode));
						return;
					}
					const page = Number(input.params?.page ?? 1);
					const pageSize = Number(input.params?.pageSize ?? 20);
					if (
						input.url !== '/synthetic/records' ||
						!Number.isInteger(page) ||
						page < 1 ||
						!Number.isInteger(pageSize) ||
						pageSize < 1 ||
						pageSize > 100
					) {
						reject(new TransportFault('business'));
						return;
					}
					const query = String(input.params?.query ?? '').toLowerCase();
					const rows =
						mode === 'empty'
							? []
							: snapshot.filter((row) => row.name.toLowerCase().includes(query));
					resolve({
						mode: 'data',
						data: {
							rows: rows.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize),
							total: rows.length,
							page,
							pageSize
						}
					});
				},
				mode === 'late' ? delay * 8 : delay
			);
		});
	}
	return {
		transport,
		setScenario,
		reset(nextSeed = seed) {
			const next = records(nextSeed, options.count);
			for (const abort of pending.values()) abort();
			seed = nextSeed;
			data = next;
			scenario = options.scenario ?? 'normal';
		},
		get pending() {
			return pending.size;
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			for (const abort of pending.values()) abort();
		}
	};
}
export function decodePage(value) {
	if (
		!value ||
		typeof value !== 'object' ||
		!('rows' in value) ||
		!Array.isArray(value.rows) ||
		!('total' in value) ||
		typeof value.total !== 'number' ||
		!('page' in value) ||
		typeof value.page !== 'number' ||
		!('pageSize' in value) ||
		typeof value.pageSize !== 'number'
	)
		throw new Error('Invalid page');
	for (const row of value.rows) {
		if (
			!row ||
			typeof row !== 'object' ||
			(!['number', 'string'].includes(typeof row.id) &&
				row.id !== null &&
				row.id !== false) ||
			typeof row.name !== 'string' ||
			typeof row.amount !== 'number' ||
			typeof row.createdAt !== 'string'
		)
			throw new Error('Invalid row');
	}
	return value;
}

import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAlert,
	AsamAvatar,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamStep,
	AsamSteps,
	AsamTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { contextKey } from './context.js';
const context = inject(contextKey);
if (!context) throw new Error('Host context required');
const { navigation, preferences, i18n } = context;
const dark = computed(() => preferences.colorMode.value === 'dark');
const container = useTemplateRef('container');
const compact = shallowRef(false);
let observer;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!container.value) return;
	observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
		if (entry) compact.value = entry.contentRect.width < 640;
	});
	observer.observe(container.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
const open = (path) => navigation.navigate(path);
const toggleTheme = () => preferences.choose({ theme: dark.value ? 'light' : 'dark' });
</script>

import { computed, createApp, defineComponent, h, watch } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHashHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createNavigation } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import {
	browserStorage,
	createPreferences,
	bindPreferencesI18n
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { createRequestClient, createTransportProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { scaffoldMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import App from './App.vue';
import DataPage from './DataPage.vue';
import AboutPage from './AboutPage.vue';
import WelcomePage from './WelcomePage.vue';
import WorkspaceGuide from './WorkspaceGuide.vue';
import { contextKey } from './context.js';
import { createMock } from './Mock.js';
import settings from './settings.json';
/** The host owns every instance and calls the returned disposer before remounting. */
export function mountApplication(element, onError) {
	return mountScaffold(element, '/data', onError);
}
/** 独立欢迎入口；默认数据入口及其销毁契约保持一致。 */
export function mountWelcome(element, onError, host) {
	return mountScaffold(element, '/welcome', onError, host);
}
async function mountScaffold(element, initialPath, onError, host) {
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHashHistory(),
		routes: [
			{
				path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*',
				component: defineComponent(
					() => () => h('p', i18n.t('app.templates.scaffold.unmatched'))
				)
			}
		]
	});
	const mock = createMock({ seed: settings.seed, scenario: settings.scenario });
	const preferences = createPreferences({
		app: settings.namespace,
		owner: ['synthetic-demo', 0],
		storage: browserStorage(),
		dictionaries: {
			'zh-CN': {
				welcome: '欢迎',
				data: '合成数据',
				about: '工程说明',
				search: '查询',
				reset: '恢复默认',
				cancel: '取消',
				title: '可复现数据演示'
			},
			'en-US': {
				welcome: 'Welcome',
				data: 'Synthetic data',
				about: 'About',
				search: 'Search',
				reset: 'Reset',
				cancel: 'Cancel',
				title: 'Reproducible data demo'
			}
		},
		fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN',
		initial: { locale: settings.locale, theme: settings.theme },
		system: window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
	});
	const stopHostLocale = host?.i18n
		? watch(
				host.i18n.locale,
				(locale) => preferences.choose({ locale: locale === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN' }),
				{ immediate: true }
			)
		: undefined;
	const stopHostTheme = host?.onThemeChange
		? watch(preferences.colorMode, (theme) => host.onThemeChange?.(theme))
		: undefined;
	// Preserve the historical stored en-US ID; adapt this template's explicit choice to builtin en.
	const componentLocale = computed(() =>
		preferences.locale.value === 'en-US' ? 'en' : preferences.locale.value
	);
	const preferenceScope = bindPreferencesI18n(
		{ locale: componentLocale },
		{ fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN' }
	);
	const i18n = extendAsamI18n(preferenceScope, scaffoldMessageDefaults);
	const welcome = initialPath === '/welcome';
	const client = createRequestClient({ i18n, transport: mock.transport });
	const coreItems = [
		{
			id: 'welcome',
			path: '/welcome',
			resource: 'welcome',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.welcome'
		},
		{
			id: 'data',
			path: '/data',
			resource: 'data',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.data',
			pinned: true
		},
		{ id: 'about', path: '/about', resource: 'about', title: 'app.templates.scaffold.about' }
	];
	const guideItems = [
		{
			id: 'scenarios',
			path: '/scenarios',
			resource: 'scenarios',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.scenarios'
		},
		{
			id: 'appearance',
			path: '/appearance',
			resource: 'appearance',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.appearance'
		},
		{
			id: 'integration',
			path: '/integration',
			resource: 'integration',
			title: 'app.templates.scaffold.integration'
		}
	];
	const items = welcome ? [...coreItems, ...guideItems] : coreItems;
	const guides = Object.fromEntries(
		guideItems.map(({ id }) => [
			id,
			defineComponent(() => () => h(WorkspaceGuide, { page: id }))
		])
	);
	const controller = createNavigation({
		i18n,
		router,
		components: { data: DataPage, about: AboutPage, welcome: WelcomePage, ...guides },
		load: async () => items.map((item) => ({ ...item, title: i18n.t(item.title) })),
		fallback: '/',
		scope: `${settings.namespace}:synthetic`
	});
	// Explicit template-owned menu IDs; only the displayed title changes with the locale.
	const title = (id, fallback) => {
		const item = items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
		return item ? i18n.t(item.title) : fallback;
	};
	const navigation = {
		...controller,
		visibleMenu: computed(() =>
			controller.visibleMenu.value.map((item) => ({
				...item,
				title: title(item.id, item.title)
			}))
		),
		tabs: computed(() =>
			controller.tabs.value.map((tab) => ({ ...tab, title: title(tab.routeId, tab.title) }))
		)
	};
	const app = createApp(App, { welcome }).use(router);
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.provide(contextKey, {
		navigation,
		preferences,
		i18n,
		client,
		mock,
		hostLocale: !!host?.i18n,
		hostTheme: !!host?.onThemeChange
	});
	provideAsamData(app, createTransportProvider(client));
	await navigation.reload();
	await router.isReady();
	if (router.currentRoute.value.path === '/') await navigation.navigate(initialPath, true);
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		stopHostLocale?.();
		stopHostTheme?.();
		app.unmount();
		navigation.dispose();
		client.dispose();
		mock.dispose();
		i18n.dispose();
		preferenceScope.dispose();
		preferences.dispose();
	};
}

export const contextKey = Symbol('scaffold-host');

{
	"title": "ASAM 脚手架合成应用预览",
	"locale": "zh-CN",
	"theme": "light",
	"seed": 20261018,
	"scenario": "normal",
	"namespace": "asam-website-scaffold"
}

从欢迎入口进入同一应用的数据工作区与工程说明，并选择自己的工作外观。页面真实复用 ASAM 组件、导航和偏好，不连接真实账号或业务后台。

页面组成

欢迎信息、工作空间摘要、三个开始指南和建议接入顺序。桌面内容居中，默认最大宽度 1120px，窄屏随容器重排。明暗、中英文与四档控件尺寸沿用应用上下文。

顶部控件

  • 通过侧栏打开页面，点击顶部页签切换。非固定页签可点击内置关闭图标或按 Delete 关闭。
  • 刷新会重新加载当前标签页的内容。
  • 关闭其他标签保留当前标签和固定标签，关闭全部保留固定标签。
  • 更新菜单重新读取导航资源，并按最新菜单更新可访问入口。
  • 语言、外观和尺寸分别切换界面语言、主题及控件密度。

接入与资源归属

独立工程调用 mountWelcome(element, onError?) 并持有返回的销毁函数。数据页、说明页和欢迎页共享同一导航、Mock、请求与偏好实例；现有 mountApplication 的默认数据入口保留。替换业务接口时使用应用的 transport/provider，账号与权限由宿主提供。

可选 WelcomeHost 接收外部 i18n 和主题变更通知。网站预览使用它同步外层控件；独立下载工程使用应用自身的语言和主题控件。销毁时停止本实例订阅，不销毁宿主的外部 i18n。

结构化页面资料

下载页面结构与接入边界 JSON，与上方 TS/JS 完整源码配合使用。

本页内容
应用欢迎页页面组成顶部控件接入与资源归属结构化页面资料
